skill.displayName: Block for OpenClaw - Spend anywhere or request payment from anyone.
skill.summary: Let your agent shop on Amazon with guardrailed wallets and owner approval.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Introduced CreditClaw Amazon Shopping skill: securely manage agent spending with owner approval and multiple guardrailed payment rails.
- Added support for Encrypted Card, Stripe Wallet (x402, Private Beta), and upcoming Crossmint Wallet payment methods.
- Detailed comprehensive security measures, including encrypted card handling, server-side spending limits, single-use claim tokens, and ephemeral sub-agents.
- Provided integration instructions, file structure, and API endpoint documentation for setup and agent usage.
- Outlined default safety settings and owner controls for spending and approvals.
